sections.title: 对现有观点的影响

sections.body:
### Reported quarterly revenue growth

- ACN：stance=positive；observed=quarterly_revenue_yoy_growth；unresolved=none
  - 差异：The lane selected the Revenues US-GAAP concept for Accenture's fiscal quarter.
  - 观察点：Compare subsequent fiscal-quarter claims by reported year-over-year rate rather than calendar-quarter labels.
- CTSH：stance=positive；observed=quarterly_revenue_yoy_growth；unresolved=none
  - 差异：The lane's available latest same-filing comparison is calendar Q1 2026.
  - 观察点：Refresh when a later Cognizant 10-Q is available through the Company Facts lane.
- EPAM：stance=positive；observed=quarterly_revenue_yoy_growth；unresolved=none
  - 差异：The lane selected RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax for EPAM.
  - 观察点：Keep the permitted US-GAAP concept difference visible in cross-company comparisons.
- IBM：stance=positive；observed=quarterly_revenue_yoy_growth；unresolved=none
  - 差异：The lane selected the Revenues US-GAAP concept for IBM's calendar quarter.
  - 观察点：Compare subsequent periods on the same-filing year-over-year basis and keep IBM's broader business mix visible.
- DXC：stance=negative；observed=quarterly_revenue_yoy_growth；unresolved=none
  - 差异：DXC's lane period is fiscal Q1 FY2027, filed 2026-07-31 as calendar Q2 2026.
  - 观察点：Watch whether DXC's year-over-year revenue decline narrows over the next two fiscal quarters.
